trial_court: HIGH COURT OF CHHATTISGARH, BILASPUR, Cr.M.P.No.1075 of 2019
case_name: Nand Kishore Pandey vs State Of Chhattisgarh

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Nand Kishore Pandey, Sumit Pandey, Nitin Pandey, Seema Pandey (husband, son, son, wife)
parties.respondent_defendant: State of Chhattisgarh through Police Station Mahila Thana, Distt.Raipur (Chhattisgarh), Smt.Mansi Choubey

facts_of_case: Marriage of respondent No.2 was solemnized with son of petitioners No.1 and 4. Out of their wedlock they were blessed with a girl child. Petitioners started treating her with cruelty by demanding ₹1 crore or house at Jabalpur.

legal_principles.principle: The power of quashing a criminal proceeding should be exercised very sparingly and with circumspection, and only in the rarest of rare cases.
legal_principles.held: We also give a note of caution to the effect that the power of quashing a criminal proceeding should be exercised very sparingly and with circumspection and that too in the rarest of rare cases;
cited_cases: Google India Private Limited v. Visaka Industries
Ahmad Ali Quraishi and another v. State of Uttar Pradesh and another
Dr Dhruvaram Murlidhar Sonar v. State of Maharashtra and others

legal_principles.principle: The court will not be justified in embarking upon an enquiry as to the reliability or genuineness or otherwise of the allegations made in the FIR or the complaint.
legal_principles.held: that the court will not be justified in embarking upon an enquiry as to the reliability or genuineness or otherwise of the allegations made in the FIR or the complaint
